findings.historical_vs_frozen: Only the B08 .18 and B08 .26 physical IDs overlap by explicit ID. The other six historical source rows (B08 .22 at uz0.4/.5 and four COL rows) do not equal frozen Root1093 rows. The overlap does not turn the count-zero historical source batch into the actual first8; Root1093 decision records are the actual authority.
findings.frozen_vs_exact24: Five frozen actual rows are current exact24 IDs. Three frozen actual rows are accepted central/alias IDs outside the current exact24 source-plan rows: normalized central gap .22/uz .5 and the B08 .18/.26 central aliases. Therefore frozen actual first8 is not certified as a subset of current exact24.
findings.frozen_vs_accepted48: All eight frozen Root1093 physical IDs occur in fresh150 checkpoint-192 accepted48. This is an accepted-membership relationship only and does not rewrite source-plan roles.
findings.exact24_vs_accepted48: All 24 current exact24 physical IDs occur in the checkpoint-192 accepted48. The exact24 source plan remains distinct from the larger accepted48 roster.
findings.preserved_gap: There is no authoritative first8-to-current-exact24 subset claim. Historical candidates, Root1093 frozen actual first8, current exact24, and accepted48 remain separate named sets.
